verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a general event-rules capability, such as an events service that matches resource events and triggers functions, notifications or other actions. The closest item is budget alerts that notify on projected overspend, which is a related but different feature. The community cronjob is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
